switches.name: implementation_stack

value_descriptions.native_rollbacks: native implementations for the token selector, sort, integer frontend, SwiGLU, fc1 weight-gradient and parameter sync

value_descriptions.production_qsa_memo_segsum: the production implementations plus QSA fast-mask v1, a host-sync memo and the segmented-sum MoE combine
value_descriptions.systems_policy: the production implementations plus the replay / segmented-sum / QSA fast-mask v2 path, configured by the systems switches

switches.name: retain_attention_prefix
switches.description: Whether the activations of the attention prefix of the 11 QSA layers (3, 7, ..., 43) are kept from the forward pass instead of being recomputed in the backward pass.

switches.name: retain_expert_layers
switches.description: Whether the expert part of decoder layers 0 and 23 is kept from the forward pass instead of being replayed in the backward pass (requires retain_attention_prefix).

switches.name: qkv_subgroup
switches.description: Whether the QKV projections run through the subgroup training path.

switches.name: shared_master_guard
switches.description: Whether the master parameters are packed through the shared-master guard.
